0022600196.text: The Bulls (1-7, 0-2 at home, on a six-game losing streak) host the 8-1 Philadelphia 76ers, who lead the East and have won five straight, in the 9th game of Chicago's season. Nic Claxton is out with a hamstring strain for the Bulls, while Jalen Smith (hand) and Zach Collins (illness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, and Philadelphia is without Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture). Philadelphia beat Chicago 126-107 in their last meeting in Philadelphia on November 2, leaving the Bulls trailing 0-1 this season after winning the 2025-26 series 2-1.
